items.title: 3 Defense Tech Stocks Investors May Prefer Over Nvidia Right Now

It ripples across defense, cybersecurity, and secure semiconductor stocks that sit closer to Washington’s priority lists and export rules. That mix of scrutiny and potential policy shifts can reshuffle where capital flows next. items.title: Google Wins the AFP 2026 Pinnacle Awards
items.summary: The Association for Financial Professionals (AFP) announced Google as the Grand Prize winner of the AFP 2026 Pinnacle Awards, sponsored by Truist. The Pinnacle Awards were presented during AFP 2026 in Las Vegas. As part of the Grand Prize, Truist donated $10,000 to The Just One Project on behalf of the winner.

items.title: AI Search Is Killing the Click. Breaker Says B2B Growth Must Move Beyond Traffic
items.summary: Artificial intelligence is weakening a metric B2B marketers have long treated as evidence that content is working: the website visit. Pew Research Center found users clicked traditional search results in 8% of visits containing a Google AI summary, compared with 15% of visits without one. Links inside the AI summaries received clicks in only 1% of visits.

items.title: Netwrix Appoints Former Google Executive Tony Orlando as Chief Revenue Officer
items.summary: Netwrix, a recognized leader in identity and data security, today announced the appointment of Tony Orlando as Chief Revenue Officer (CRO). Orlando will lead Netwrix's global revenue organization, with a focus on accelerating partner-led growth and expanding market reach.
